description.value: You instantly and truly know one specific fact about the target — no save, no resistance — at a small immediate personal cost: you lose 1 point of maximum HP until your next daily preparations, as something of yours is spent to buy the fact outright.

cinderfall.incomplete: The self max-HP loss ('until your next daily preparations') is potentially buildable via ActiveEffectLike on a daily-expiring companion effect, but the rule-elements guide's only worked example (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/general/level-1/diehard.json:30-32) uses mode:"upgrade"; no mode:"downgrade" example against system.attributes.hp.max specifically was found or verified, so this is not shipped as a ready block. The pure-info half of this card needs no rule element (PAT-EMPTY) and is not a gap. See feats-class-reckoner-draft.md open question 6.
